text_block_list.text:
Today is interview day. A reporter is 
scheduled to visit the academy in three 
hours, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
......Hey. The setting sun is displeasing. 
Deal with it.
choice_data_list: A-Ah! Don't close the curtains!
Y-Yeah! I'll close the curtains!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Tch...
choice_data_list: あ、ああ！カーテン閉めるな！
う、うん！カーテン閉めるね！
choice_data_list_en: Ah, whoa! Don't close the curtains!

text_block_list.text:
—Of all days, Orfevre had to be in an 
extraordinarily foul mood...!
choice_data_list:
(I have to do something before the 
reporters get here!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Steak. I desire steak.
choice_data_list: （記者が来る前に、なんとかしないと！）
choice_data_list_en: (I need to do something before the reporters get here!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...So what?
choice_data_list: あの……ステーキはメニューにないんだけど
choice_data_list_en: Um... steak isn't on the menu, though.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Tell me one thing. Why do your legs exist?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
In whose service do you lay down your 
life? —Answer me.
choice_data_list: I-I'll go buy it right away!! In a flash!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ......Boring.
choice_data_list: か、買ってきます！！ダッシュで！
choice_data_list_en: I-I'll go buy some!! At a full sprint!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What insolence. To put a king to work, 
making him earn daily wages.
choice_data_list: ……ボードゲーム、楽しくない？

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Why is it missing? From the list of 
occupations—'King.'"
choice_data_list:
Oh, how about we make an original one? 
That profession

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Enough. Take it away.
choice_data_list: お、オリジナルで作ってみようか！その職業
choice_data_list_en: Oh, why don't we create our own version of that job!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Now, make haste and present it. The next 
amusement.

In the end, without being able to put 
Orfevre in a better mood, interview time 
drew near—and on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I'm so sorry! It was my 
carelessness! Orfe-san's tail is...!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: I-I have a towel, let me wipe it off!
I-I have a towel, let me wipe it off!

text_block_list.text:
I carefully wipe Orfevre's tail, which had 
gotten wet with orange juice. ...At that 
moment, a memory came back to me.
choice_data_list: た、タオル持ってるから、俺が拭くよ！
た、タオル持ってるから、私が拭くね！
choice_data_list_en: I-I've got a towel, so let me dry you off!
I-I've got a towel, so let me dry you off!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—You fool. You touched it, didn't you? The 
King's tail.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, not at all...! Our hands just 
brushed against each other a little...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You deserve ten thousand deaths. Prostrate 
yourself and apologize.
choice_data_list:
(......I might have really messed up this 
time!)

text_block_list.text:
I frantically apologize for touching her 
tail. To which Orfevre—
choice_data_list: （…………これは、やってしまったかも！）

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Very well.
choice_data_list: Huh... A-Are you sure?
Huh... A-Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Ah, you may dispense with formalities.
choice_data_list: え……い、いいのか？
え……い、いいの？
choice_data_list_en: Huh... A-Are you sure about that?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Because I'm in that sort of mood, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So the secret to your strength, 
Orfevre-san, is the fruit of your daily 
devotion!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. I am a King. Therefore, I desire 
only hardship worthy of me.
choice_data_list:
(Thank goodness... she's really in a 
better mood!)

text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I had no idea what had 
triggered her mood swing, but—unbeknownst 
to anyone, I let out a sigh of relief.
choice_data_list: （よかった……機嫌、本当に直ってる！）
choice_data_list_en: (Thank goodness... She really is back in a good mood!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, we'd also like to ask Orfe-san's 
Trainer for a few words!
choice_data_list:
I will continue to serve her with all my 
strength!

I'll get stronger so I can provide even 
better support!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...Indeed. That is your duty."
choice_data_list: これからも彼女に尽くします、体力の限り！
よりよいサポートができるよう力をつけます
choice_data_list_en: I'll keep dedicating myself to her with every ounce of strength I have!
I'll build up my skills so I can offer you even better support.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A king needs loyal retainers. Never forget 
that.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, come to think of it. I haven't told 
you yet, have I?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Thy devotion on this occasion was 
commendable. —Continue thy diligent 
efforts without faltering.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph... What an obvious thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
“However, it is good. You stated it 
publicly— you proclaimed it. That is 
worthy of praise.”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Devote yourself diligently, so that you 
do not become all talk."
